UPDATE
    jobs
SET
    status = 'Pending',
    done_at = NULL,
    lock_by = NULL,
    lock_at = NULL,
    attempts = attempts + 1,
    last_result = '{"Err": "Re-enqueued due to worker shutdown"}'
WHERE
    id IN (
        SELECT
            abandoned.id
        FROM (
            SELECT
                jobs.id AS id
            FROM
                jobs
                INNER JOIN workers ON lock_by = workers.id
            WHERE
                status = 'Queued'
                AND workers.worker_type = ?
                AND workers.id = ?
                AND jobs.id IN (
                    SELECT
                        jt.value
                    FROM
                        JSON_TABLE(
                            JSON_EXTRACT(?, '$'), '$[*]'
                            COLUMNS (value VARCHAR(36) PATH '$')
                        ) AS jt
                )
        ) AS abandoned
    );
